Fixed a major bug
This bug would directly cause a1 to fail to obtain configuration and thus fail to run. Simply put, if someone mounted `/etc`, a1's detection would misjudge rootless as rootful/roothide, causing rootless configuration retrieval to fail. So the detection method was improved, using dpkg to obtain the current jailbreak environment, and then using it to obtain other configurations
Allow modification of the flock mechanism
Previously the lock mechanism was not modifiable. This update, because AD successfully implemented Linux flock, the lock mechanism was refactored. Now the lock mechanism allows you to enable or disable it (enabled by default). If you choose to disable it, the configuration file may be corrupted due to multiple processes modifying the same configuration file simultaneously, but it brings multithreading and concurrency. If you choose to enable it, the configuration data is guaranteed and will not be corrupted due to multi-process issues, but the disadvantage is single-threading
